benchmark.name: Inception42
benchmark.takeawayArabic: مهمة محددة، ثم واجهة مرئية، ثم مخرجات قبل العمل وأثناءه وبعده.
observed: Full-bleed changing hero photography/video occupies the entire composition with overlay typography and a small centered brand-grid motif. Image edges are not shown as a separate card or square.

Thin grid rules, generous space, asymmetrical feature panels, editorial bands, product image tiles, model presentation, partner strip and dated news create different visual rhythms instead of a page of matching cards.
Bright chartreuse actions and occasional purple panels are distinctive to this brand; they are not a recommendation to recolor AGYNEXA.
Named products have a short task descriptor; partner logos and dated announcements supply inspectable pointers to company-provided evidence.
limits: Cookie banner overlays part of the hero and product screenshots. No cookie settings were changed.
Initial screenshot preceded the navigation entrance; one settled capture shows the navigation fully.

limits: Do not adopt heavy animation that delays a readable static hero. Do not import partner names, research claims or industrial product credentials.

benchmark.name: Presight

observed: The headline is large and short, supported by a compact body block and one clear gradient CTA.
Subtle arcs form a continuous dark hero background; artwork supports the text instead of appearing as a pasted object.
The first section after the hero is a restrained grayscale Trusted by logo strip.

Lower-page narrative details are text/DOM observations only, explicitly separated from visual observations. No further retries.

benchmark.name: HUMAIN
benchmark.takeawayArabic: رسم ممتد ضمن الخلفية ولغة بصرية مستمرة وصفوف تحريرية متنوعة.
observed: Settled hero uses dark teal/green layered geometric depth across the whole background, extending behind navigation and copy. It reads as one environment, not a framed illustration.

Below the hero: editorial content carousel, a centered stack statement, compact named-allies strip, then four alternating image/text rows: Applications & Solutions, AI Models, Data Platform, Infrastructure.
A repeated abstract graphic language ties the four layer illustrations together. Generous whitespace and alternating axes keep the long story from becoming a repetitive grid.
A PIF-company mark is displayed in the footer; allies shown include named technology providers. These are publisher claims, not independently verified here.
limits: The initial page captured before assets/hydration finished. One settled capture produced the actual imagery and lower-page content, while a consent modal still obscures the precise hero wording. No consent was accepted/rejected and no further retry was made.
Cookie-modal text dominates the extracted visible DOM text, so lower-page observations are derived directly from screenshot inspection.
No separate HUMAIN product page was visited; the homepage itself exposes the relevant stack composition.

evidenceLimits: Public rendered pages and selected product pages only; no authenticated competitor products or backend/integration tests.
AIQ homepage capture remained incomplete after one diagnosed retry; Capabilities was inspected.
Presight lower-page paint was incomplete; lower-page DOM text is not described as visual evidence.

One reviewer stage; analyst/planner agents are created but not invoked.
Two sequential stages, not all three.

qualityFindings.title: Fixed business answers bypass the models
qualityFindings.fact: Missing-data revisions and initial review-only purchase designs can skip all three model roles and ignore supplied details.
qualityFindings.impact: A user can see the same generic response after different concrete requests despite having three configured credentials.
qualityFindings.improvement: Keep immutable safety decisions as structured constraints; allow the model to answer the actual design/amendment using supplied facts. Reserve hard-coded text for brief genuine boundary/error states, not whole useful business drafts.

qualityFindings.title: Routing uses keywords rather than task intent/state
qualityFindings.fact: Terms such as invoice/approval/purchase route to workflow before calculation/technical checks. Follow-ups inherit only a preceding user request through prefix regexes.
qualityFindings.impact: An invoice calculation may invoke the full design chain; a nuanced question may force a design tool or lose the task frame. This is a mechanism, not a measured error rate.
qualityFindings.improvement: Use a bounded typed intent decision with explicit latest action (answer, clarify, calculate, design, amend, compare) and conversation task state, while server code retains tool allowlists. Preserve a cheap direct path for simple requests.

qualityFindings.title: Duplicated instructions and special cases dominate each role
qualityFindings.fact: publicRoleInstructions supplies common boundary/role wording, then agentInstructions appends overlapping role text and many case-specific rules. Initial designs are capped at 4–6 steps/350 words; followups can receive a second hard 180-word/three-paragraph rule.
qualityFindings.impact: These rules can overfit safety cases and restrict a legitimate deep follow-up. They are a plausible contributor to stiff/repetitive output; no new evaluation establishes causality for every bad answer.
qualityFindings.improvement: Consolidate one capability policy plus concise role purpose, allowed proposals and response principles. Make length depend on the user's requested depth. Ask the one question that materially changes the task, not a mandatory generic intake question.

qualityFindings.title: Reviewer completion checks only nonempty text
qualityFindings.fact: Analyst and planner state are strings, final output schema is {text:string}, and success checks require nonempty review text. Tool gaps reach reviewer as prompt text, not a validated final compliance/completeness contract.
qualityFindings.impact: A fluent answer can omit an important user requirement, tool gap, correction or requested deliverable and still be considered completed.
qualityFindings.improvement: Maintain a small typed task/requirements/draft state behind chat. Deterministically validate known constraints and output completeness before marking a useful result ready; render natural prose without forcing a visible result card.

qualityFindings.title: Recent-message window has no stable decision memory
qualityFindings.fact: Client projection keeps at most twelve complete text messages and twelve thousand characters, then drops older turns. No canonical goal/decisions/open-questions object survives outside that window.
qualityFindings.impact: Long conversations can lose corrections, prior inputs and task decisions. There is no durable memory even when logged in.
qualityFindings.improvement: Keep a bounded session task state of user-confirmed goal, constraints, corrections, known facts and open questions; include it within the existing aggregate context budget. Distinguish user facts from assistant proposals.

qualityFindings.title: Tool set cannot fulfill general execution/research expectations
qualityFindings.fact: Only design review, workload arithmetic and three fixed official technical references are available. Reviewer has no tools. Public chat cannot browse arbitrary sources, run code, send email or access business systems.
qualityFindings.impact: The assistant must offer useful analysis/drafting within this scope, but cannot honestly execute tasks outside it. A key or extra role does not add tools.
qualityFindings.improvement: State relevant limitation once when needed, then deliver a concrete useful allowed result or ask a targeted question. Do not answer ordinary design questions with a broad catalogue of things unavailable.

qualityFindings.title: Three-stage chain is not a quality feedback loop
qualityFindings.fact: Three roles pass prose forward sequentially; final reviewer has no tools and no bounded critique/revise step back to planner. Analyst and planner use the same model ID.
qualityFindings.impact: More stages/keys do not establish independent verification or better task completion.
qualityFindings.improvement: Define each role's contribution and acceptance evidence. Use one/two stages for simple work and full planning only when needed. Consider a bounded correction only when a specific completeness check fails; never add automatic loops or a third model merely for appearance.

agentDiagnosis.measuredModelStrength: Not evaluated; keys and model size alone do not establish answer quality.
agentDiagnosis.priorQualityEvidence: The earlier fictional procurement response supplied a financial approval threshold not provided by the user and presented generated details as based on supplied data. This is a semantic-quality issue; earlier successful HTTP/stream/export checks did not prove answer quality.

chatDesign.presentation: Retain rail and composer. Assistant prose flows directly on the dark canvas with readable headings, lists and discreet copy/export. Do not introduce a split result editor, framed answer card or forced full-answer Markdown code block.
chatDesign.frameSource: Streamdown table wrapper adds rounded border, bg-sidebar and padding plus automatic controls. Scope any removal to the assistant rendering; retain horizontal scrolling for genuinely tabular content without an outer frame/fullscreen toolbar.
chatDesign.modelFlow: Keep existing providers initially. Replace fixed business-draft responses with contextual generation while server-side safety constraints remain deterministic. Route by requested action and bounded task state; do not invoke all roles simply to use all keys.
chatDesign.memory: Carry bounded user-confirmed facts, corrections and open questions in session task state; distinguish assistant proposals from facts. Preserve aggregate context limits and cancellation.
chatDesign.qualityGate: Check that the requested output exists, uses supplied facts, preserves corrections, distinguishes assumptions, and respects actual tool results. Missing critical facts lead to one targeted question or an explicitly provisional useful draft, not a canned intake.
chatDesign.responseDepth: Adapt length to request. A small amendment changes that step; a full redesign can be complete. Arithmetic uses supplied units and values. No invented SLA, financial threshold, source, owner or reported execution.
chatDesign.scope: Useful planning, explanation, drafting and permitted calculations. A stronger model or account does not create access to company systems. Connected execution follows M8 with real authorization.
chatDesign.modelSelection: Use a bounded task-based comparison of the configured candidate models before claiming one is best. Score Arabic clarity, supplied-fact grounding, follow-up consistency, requested deliverable completion, latency and cost. The current final response already comes from GPT-OSS 120B; no unmeasured model-strength claim or model/config change is made here.

accountDesign.guest: Keep useful public assistant access without login; current session is not advertised as cloud-saved.
accountDesign.signedInValue: A protected personal workspace can save and reopen private conversations, rename/export/delete them, and show clear saved/error/expired-session states.
accountDesign.ownership: Derive identity on the server; verify session for every private operation and enforce own-user RLS. Signing up grants no enterprise membership.
dataPrerequisites: Reconcile current agentnexos_* schema, migration history and legacy TypeScript types without resetting production or creating duplicate user tables.
Set actual retention and deletion rules before activating history; update privacy notice.
Validate the full positive account/email/session flow and two-user isolation within an authorized production release.
accountDesign.historyChoice: Do not silently upload a guest conversation or enable raw-chat persistence. Clearly disclose and explicitly initiate saving. Separate structured draft/version requirements from existing plain-message tables; choose additive storage only for a real requirement.
accountDesign.productionBoundary: No auth setting, schema, user record, retention scheduler or access policy changed during this comparison.
accountDesign.isolationRequirement: Keep each signed-in user’s conversations separate using verified identity and ownership checks on every read/write/delete. Do not leak or reuse one customer’s history in another session; guest import requires an explicit action.
